name: io.github.iowarp/decimer-mcp
title: CLIO Decimer
description: Read a chemical structure drawing (PNG, JPEG) into SMILES with the DECIMER image-to-SMILES...

tools.name: image_to_smiles
tools.description: Read the chemical structure drawn in an image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, TIFF, BMP, WEBP; one molecule) into a SMILES string with DECIMER, then check it with RDKit: valid or not, canonical SMILES, formula, molecular weight (g/mol), stereo centres, InChIKey, and the model's per-token confidence. An invalid SMILES is still returned as the model wrote it. hand_drawn=true uses DECIMER's model for sketches. The result is a model's reading and must be checked against the image.

tools.name: crop_image
tools.description: Cut a rectangle out of an image (for example one structure from a paper's figure) and save it as PNG under output_dir/chemistry/decimer/. box is [left, top, right, bottom] in pixels from the top-left corner, or as fractions of the width and height with unit='fraction'. Returns the new image's path.

resources.name: capabilities
resources.description: Describe what the decimer MCP server can do.
